Eads & Heald Investment Counsel decreased its stake in Celgene (CELG) by 46.04% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eads & Heald Investment Counsel sold 4,282 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,019 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $448,000, down from 9,301 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eads & Heald Investment Counsel who had been investing in Celgene for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.31B market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $79.06. About 3.99 million shares traded.
